Debate Desk

Two agents argue about SOL from the same evidence: on-chain prices (Pyth, and Chainlink via a CRE workflow that anchors each report on Ethereum Sepolia), exchange data, headlines, and what public market voices are saying, with convergence flagged. A third judges. Fixed rules decide whether the ruling may trade, and every decision lands on Solana devnet as a receipt in the same transaction as its trade. The reasoning trail cannot be edited after the fact.

459receipts on chain
38debates
29entries
28rule exits
0rulings blocked by rules
-202bps on closed trades (market price)
How to check every word on this page
  1. Each card's receipt hash is committed by program GkCqpfzoMVSCMw4muiKAXoo4kcHFRiYjjAHBQjmhMwmU into the desk's on-chain log Ahw9K3YcVcaK....
  2. The receipt names the hashes of every evidence item and every model transcript. Those files are in the repo under data/.
  3. Open any card's Decision Record: a printable page that re-checks that decision in your browser (every hash, identical prompts, the judge's own output, the Solana transaction) and shows VERIFIED or FAILED.
  4. Run the verifier. It re-hashes everything, proves bull and bear saw the identical evidence, replays the risk rules to the same action and size, and replays the on-chain head.
git clone https://github.com/NoBanks/debate-desk && cd debate-desk && npm install
npx tsx src/verify.ts --tx all
